title: CTAB Protocol for Host DNA Isolation from Symbiotic Aiptasia
author: Pringle Lab
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qx7dxrn

steps.title: Homogenize tissue in CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Homogenize each anemone individually in 500 µl 2× CTAB buffer (containing 2‑Mercaptoethanol) using a rotor‑stator in a 1.5–2 ml screw‑cap or safe‑lock microcentrifuge tube; ensure tubes are chemical‑resistant and clean the rotor afterwards.

steps.title: Shear homogenate with needle
steps.instruction: Pass the homogenate through a 25‑gauge needle five times; note that DNA degrades rapidly in SDS or water, so freeze the samples after step 6 if you will isolate DNA later.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and mix
steps.instruction: Add 3.6 µl Proteinase K (20 mg ml⁻¹) and mix by inverting several times.

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate at 65 °C for 30–60 min, inverting occasionally; the suspension should become green and less opaque (≈20 min sufficient for less dense samples).

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction (first)
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, TE‑buffered to pH ≥ 7) and vortex several seconds to form a milky emulsion; centrifuge 10 min at 14,000 ×g; transfer ~550 µl of the upper aqueous phase to a new tube without disturbing the interphase.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) (or plain chloroform) and vortex several seconds; centrifuge 10 min at 14,000 ×g; transfer ~450 µl of the upper aqueous phase to a new tube, avoiding the interphase.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml 100 % ethanol (molecular‑biology grade) to the aqueous phase and mix well; incubate at room temperature for at least 30 min.

steps.title: Pellet DNA and wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge ≥30 min at 14,000 ×g at room temperature, keeping all tubes oriented the same way; decant the supernatant carefully (pellet may be invisible); add 500 µl 70 % ethanol without mixing and centrifuge 5 min at 14,000 ×g.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and dry pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the ethanol supernatant with a pipette (use a 1000 µl pipette with a 200 µl tip) without disturbing the pellet; air‑dry the pellet for 10 min or until no ethanol is visible.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in buffer
steps.instruction: Add 30 µl ddH₂O or 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.5 (alternatively TE buffer) to the dried pellet and resuspend.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the DNA solution at –20 °C indefinitely or use it directly.

steps.title: Pellet algae and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the original extract at 10,000 ×g for 5–10 min to pellet algae; transfer the supernatant to a new tube and discard the algal pellet.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 8 µl RNase A (10 mg ml⁻¹ stock) to the supernatant, mix, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min (extend to 1 h for large samples).

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction (second)
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, TE‑buffered to pH ≥ 7) and vortex several seconds; centrifuge 10 min at 14,000 ×g; transfer ~500 µl of the upper aqueous phase to a new tube without disturbing the interphase.
